documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that Baheti Recycling Industries achieved strong financial performance in FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores, driven by improved operational efficiency and margin expansion. The company is expanding its capacity by commencing 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27, bringing total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually, and is investing in a new aluminum wire rod division in Dahegam. Management noted that global primary aluminum supply disruptions in the Middle East and government policy tailwinds are favorable for secondary recycling. Additionally, the company added several automotive OEMs like Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, and Royal Enfield as direct clients during H2. Baheti Recycling reported a good financial year for FY26, surpassing its stated revenue guidance by 12% and achieving PAT growth of over 15% above guidance.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod project targets annual revenue of 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod project will increase production to 25,000 tons and revenue by another 250 crores, bringing total plant revenue to 500 crores.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to be sustainable in the range of 7 to 10 percent.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company heads into FY27 with an order book of a minimum of 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
guidance.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

guidance.claim: The company closed the year having surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what was guided.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: The company is confidently positioned to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crore by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, pushing customers toward reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is strong, government policy tailwinds exist, and global industry dynamics favor secondary recycled aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic scrap is currently 7-8% more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no not that much, to be very honest. We have not compared, but you can say 7-8% would be expensive.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27, reflecting steady domestic demand for secondary aluminium.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and pressure on availability is real.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: A solar plant is on track and will be commenced by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: that will be combined with our solar plant, which is on track, and which will be commenced by the end of May 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant is expected to be commissioned by the end of October or early November.
capex_expansion.quote: By the end of October, you can say early November.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will require a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is putting ₹20-25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out its Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity generating between ₹200-250 Crores in annual revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Scaling to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years brings the revenue potential from the Wire Rod division to ₹500 Crores a year.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for FY27 to replace older pit furnaces.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to be up and running by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

margins_costs.claim: Entering the aluminum wire rod product segment will improve EBITDA margin by 1 or 2% from the existing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices, but was passed on to selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%. But ultimately, it has been diverted or it has been passed to our selling price, as simple as that.

margins_costs.claim: EPR implementation will directly impact PAT or decrease manufacturing cost by 2.75% through FTA help.
margins_costs.quote: This FTA will help us in. It will directly impact our PAT or you can say the cost of manufacturing will decrease by 2.75%.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces, and margin benefits will start showing up from Q2 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

orders_capacity.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively focused on reducing debt and improving key financial ratios.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, we are also working actively on avenues to make our working capital more efficient, which will be happen as we are now directly connected with the OEMs with better margins and better payment terms

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes facilities like 'build to ship to' concept at concessional or marginally higher interest rates to extend credit to 90 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We are using that product on build to ship to in terms of what we'll able to get a credit of 90 days from the financing services, like, that will not increase our debt, that will increase our creditors, so it will also impact our positive cash flow.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: The preferential issue was dropped because a major stakeholder backed out due to market conditions and internal fund constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: The market condition was the reason. The one major are you can say the stakeholder who was investing somewhere around 40-odd crores, he has backed out because of the market condition and the CIOs of their company, they were not allowing them to invest any new fund to infuse any new fund into any new company. So that is the reason we dropped that preferential issue.
